subject: Inland Revenue Department Letter: Employer's Return (BIR56A) - Tai Hang Design Studio Limited
body:
Dear Mr Jason Lam,

We have received a letter from the Inland Revenue Department for Tai Hang Design Studio Limited regarding the Employer's Return of Remuneration and Pensions (BIR56A) for the year ended 31 March 2026. You are required to complete and file the Employer's Return (BIR56A) and employee notifications (IR56B) by 21 November 2026.

A scanned copy of the letter is attached for your reference. Please let us know if you would like our assistance in preparing the return.

Best regards,
CWC CPA
